newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia funds say need more state capital to list.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia funds say need more state capital to list.

text.p: Slovenian investment funds said on Thursday they would delay a listing on the bourse until parliament passes a law that would offer additional state capital in exchange for privatisation vouchers.

"We expect the government will introduce a new law in April and if parliament passes it by the end of June we could be listed in autumn," Radovan Stonic, deputy president of the Association of Investment Companies, told Reuters.
